title: Product images have no alt text
body: Using VoiceOver on Safari, every product photo on the catalog page is read as 'image' followed by a long file name. Steps: open /catalog, swipe through items. Expected: a description of the product.

title: Tutorial videos have no captions
body: The onboarding videos on the help center have no captions at all. Deaf users can't follow them. Checked in Chrome and Firefox.

title: Form fields not associated with labels
body: On the signup form the visual labels aren't programmatically tied to inputs. NVDA just says 'edit text' for each field. Steps: tab into the email field on /signup.

title: Light grey placeholder text is hard to read
body: The grey text on white in the footer links is very faint. I measured about 2.5:1. Users with low vision complain they can't read it.

title: Can't reach the date picker with keyboard
body: The calendar widget only opens on mouse click. Pressing Enter or Space on it does nothing, so keyboard-only users cannot pick a date and cannot finish booking.

title: Modal traps keyboard focus
body: After opening the share dialog, Tab cycles inside it forever and Escape doesn't close it. There is no way to get back to the page without a mouse.

title: Session times out with no warning
body: While filling a long application form, I got logged out after 10 minutes and lost everything. There was no warning or option to extend.

title: No visible focus indicator on buttons
body: When tabbing through the nav bar there's no outline on the focused item, so I can't tell where I am. Happens on all browsers, CSS has outline: none.

title: Error message not announced
body: If you submit the payment form with a bad card number, the red error text appears but the screen reader says nothing and focus stays on the button. The user doesn't know what went wrong.

title: Icon-only close button has no accessible name
body: The X button on the chat widget is announced by TalkBack as just 'button'. Users don't know it closes the chat.

title: Please add a dark theme
body: It would be nice to have a dark mode option in settings. Lots of apps have this now.

title: CI accessibility job is flaky
body: The axe-core step in our GitHub Actions workflow times out about one run in five. Probably needs a longer wait for the dev server.
